questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I study psychology and wanted to do my fifth semester at Humboldt with the regular courses from KU at this time. It was quite difficult to find matching course for avanceret forskningsdesign but in the end I managed to combine two different courses to match avanceret and have my learning agreement accepted. My actual experience of the courses I took however was that they were heavily based on statistical methods and did not cover the videnskabsteori part at all, and that actual goes for quite a lot of the courses I took. The professors are mostly teaching quantitative methods and the papers we read were mostly quantitative. We did not read theories and discuss and criticize them in the seminars as Im used to at KU which I missed. Also I found that the multiple choice exams for the courses such was as work psychology was quite random since in my opinion there is not always just one way of understanding social settings such as work and the exam presented reality as if there is one true answer or solution to any problem which I just find a bit reductionistic in psychology.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The seminars and "holdundervisning" were quite different, since we did not discuss the material from the lectures and the professor/holdunderviser/student assistant did not really facilitate anything during the seminars except just assigned each student or small groups of students with different topics and a couple of papers we then had to present at one of the seminar sessions. Each session was then comprised of an hour long presentation from a group of students which was not relevant for the exam and did not match the teaching materials from the lectures which felt quite random

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: If you enjoy statistics and want to learn mathematical methods which can be applied in quantitative research in psychology then Modul 01 Advanced Empirical Research Methodology with professor Fritz Günther was quite different and elaborate compared to any course Im aware of at KU.

questions.answer: its always difficult to be around new people most of the time, but everyone was so cute and helpful and friendly

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: people being more open and talkative

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Try to find courses without a multiple choice exam. For me it was too reductionistic compared to how I understand psychology and human beings and I think the whole field of psychology in germany is quite more quantitative based compared to KU which was quite surprising and not the most enjoyable for me personally. So its just something to keep in mind. besides that - take the german course offered before the semester starts and enjoy the city
